note: The domestic analysis argues the risk is digitising the existing fragmentation rather than failing to digitise.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Link between the government payroll system and the national identity database
milestone: Announced 2026-08-30
position_end: the accountant general's office moving to link the government payroll system with the national identity database

subject: dpi.exchange
name: RAAD primary-care electronic health record
milestone: Deployed in 111 facilities across six states, 2023 to 2025
position_end: 111 facilities across six states, aligned to the national platform's interoperability and indicator standards so clinical data generates compliant aggregate reports automatically, raising reporting completeness from 85 to 96 per cent

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Revenue and financial-management systems integrated with SFMIS
milestone: Auditor-General's 2025 annual audit
position_end: Seven government revenue and financial-management systems are not integrated with the state financial management information system, on the Auditor-General's 2025 annual audit; the same audit records 66 legal-compliance breaches across 22 audited bodies covering 60.1% of the national budget, including US$18.5m of contracts awarded without following committee procedures, and finds a port and airport revenue-share operator's reporting of US$38.08m of a combined US$42.24m could not be verified
note: the auditor general's summary compliance audit report is held as a citation page only, so the figures are as reported from it, and the seven systems are not named

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Unified Social Registry and Social Protection Delivery System
milestone: Supporting over 500,000 households; additional financing approved May 2026
position_start: Government-owned platforms with no drought-response scaling
position_end: Established government-owned platforms supporting over 500,000 households, carrying a USD 35 million crisis-response grant scaling digital and mobile cash transfers

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric passport and travel-data exchange
milestone: Immigration agency briefs the African Union counterterrorism centre, 16 September 2026
position_end: The immigration and citizenship agency presented its biometric passport, electronic visa and exchange of travel data to the African Union's counterterrorism centre as the basis of border security and counterterrorism cooperation; no issuance figure, enrolment coverage or data-sharing instrument is published
note: the exchange of travel data is described as cooperation rather than as an agreement, and no legal basis for it is named

subject: dpi.id
name: Certificate Delivery System
milestone: Launched by NIRA at Mogadishu, 7 May 2025
position_end: Lets registered people download their registration certificates, launched with the verification platform and the mobile ID app and built in-house by NIRA with World Bank project support; no download count is published

subject: dpi.id
name: Compulsory use of the national identity credential
milestone: Enforced at Aden Adde airport for inter-state travel from March 2026
position_start: Required for bank accounts under a Central Bank measure introduced in July 2025 and effective from 1 September, and for driving licences and vehicle registration (2025-08)
position_end: Required for passports, bank accounts, driving licences and vehicle registration, and enforced at the capital's airport for travel between federal states (2026-03)
note: A published legal analysis holds that the presidential proclamation of September 2025 exceeds Law 009/2023, which confers a right to an identity credential and imposes no duty to obtain one; the two accounts have not been reconciled.

subject: dpi.id
name: eAqoonsi mobile identity application
milestone: Public adoption call renewed; app past 50,000 downloads
position_start: Launched alongside the HUBIYE verification platform and the certificate delivery system, all built in-house (2025-05)
position_end: The identification and registration authority renewed its public call for citizens to adopt the digital identity application, restating that the app-held credential is legally equivalent to the physical national identity card; the app had passed 50,000 downloads by August 2026 against more than one million digital identities issued as of November 2025, a stated target of 15 million by 2029, and an estimated US$125m still needed to implement the donor-funded programme in full, with inclusion complaints over weak connectivity and low digital literacy reported in April 2026

subject: dpi.id
name: HUBIYE consent-based verification platform
milestone: Launched with the certificate delivery system and the mobile identity application
position_start: In service as the verification layer for the national identity credential (2025-08)
position_end: In service; no verification volume or integrated-institution count published (2026-08)

subject: dpi.id
name: Member state participation in the national identity system
status: Implemented, not adopted in two member states
milestone: Puntland operating its own identification authority
position_start: Puntland and Jubbaland declining to implement the federal credential (2025-08)
position_end: Position unchanged, with Puntland running a separate authority and citing data control, election influence and regional autonomy (2025-09)

subject: dpi.id
name: National Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Policy
milestone: Issued January 2021
position_end: In force as policy, with the assessment behind it finding no operational national civil-registration office and 4 per cent of under-twos registered

subject: dpi.id
name: National ID requirement for SIM cards
milestone: Announced at the close of National Identification Week, September 2026
position_end: The information minister said access to communication services, including SIM cards, will depend on holding the national identity credential; no rule, date or enforcing body published
note: a ministerial statement at a conference, not an issued instrument

subject: dpi.id
name: National identity enrolment
milestone: More than 1.5 million registered since 2023 against 15 million by 2029
position_end: The identity and registration authority has registered more than 1.5 million citizens since 2023, against a stated target of 15 million citizens and residents by 2029 - about a tenth of the way, with three years to run. The interior minister said on 19 September 2026 that issuance would be extended to embassies abroad and that priority goes to persons with disabilities and displaced communities. No breakdown by region, sex or age, and no issuance rate, is published

subject: dpi.id
name: National identity integration with the HALMEEL public service centre
milestone: Integration under way, reported 2026-10-19
position_start: Planned, with an area set aside for the identity authority at the service centre (2026-10-06)
position_end: The service centre is integrating its systems with the identity authority, and the national ID is the only identification it accepts at its Mogadishu centre (2026-10)

subject: dpi.id
name: National identity requirement for domestic travel
milestone: Enforced from 2026-10-01; passengers refused boarding at Garowe
position_start: Postponed from 1 January to 1 March 2026, with no enforcement on file
position_end: The federal government began enforcing the national identity card requirement for domestic travel on 1 October 2026, and passengers at Garowe in Puntland, where the identification authority keeps no registration offices, were refused boarding on flights to Mogadishu and Nairobi; the authority had announced the date in September and says it has registered more than 1.5 million people since 2023 against a target of 15 million by 2029
note: no count of passengers turned back is given

subject: dpi.id
name: National passport
milestone: Cabinet approved a third-generation e-passport plan, 6 August 2026
position_start: 10m passports in circulation with no record of how many were lawfully issued (2025-09)
position_end: Cleared in February 2026 to adopt and print the East African Community e-passport, and a third-generation plan approved by Cabinet; no issuance date published (2026-08)
sources: 2026-08-06-somali-cabinet-approves-third-generation-e-passport-plan|2026-02-17 Somalia cleared to adopt and print EAC e-Passport|2025-09-19-hassan-sheikh-10m-passports-id-overhaul

subject: dpi.id
name: Prime ministerial directive on integration with HUBIYE
milestone: Directive of 21 April 2025
position_end: Mandates integration of all public-facing services with NIRA's verification platform for identity verification; no count of integrated institutions is published under it

subject: dpi.id
name: Proposed national ID requirement for social media accounts
milestone: Requested by the deputy prime minister at a federal communication forum, 2026-09-07
position_end: The deputy prime minister asked the information ministry to write into its rules a requirement that social media accounts be opened with the national identity number, against a credential about 2m people hold
note: no draft rule, legal basis or treatment of people without the credential is published; commentators ask for a rights test

subject: dpi.id
name: Somali National Identity credential (SNID)
milestone: About 2m registered by April 2026
position_start: Issued since September 2023 from a near-zero base, with mass registration not yet launched (2025-08)
position_end: About 2m registered against a target of 15m by the end of 2029, with more than 24 services integrated (2026-04)
sources: 2026-04-24-somalia-eaqoonsi-app-dpi|2025-11-26-somalia-national-id-issuance-reaches-1m|2025-09-17 Somalia launches mass registration drive for its foundational digital ID|2025-06-02 Somalia walking a thorny road to an inclusive national digital ID system|2025-11-27 Somalia's Digital ID - A Milestone on the Roadmap Towards Effective Governance
note: NIRA's director general put about 85% of an estimated 19.7m population as holding no legal identity in June 2025, and fewer than 16% held a government-issued document at the 2022 household survey.

subject: dpi.pay
name: EVC Plus mobile money
milestone: GSMA Mobile Money re-certified, August 2025
position_start: Operating as the dominant private rail, uncertified in the current cycle (2025-08)
position_end: Re-certified against about 300 criteria, one of about ten platforms worldwide to hold it, serving 4.5m daily users and used by more than 145 aid organisations (2025-08)
note: Nationally, mobile money runs about 155m transactions a month worth US$2.7bn on World Bank figures, against formal banking reaching about 15% of Somalis.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mandatory digital revenue receipts
milestone: Binding circular released 4 January 2026
position_end: A binding finance ministry circular mandating digital revenue receipts, alongside a revenue portal, an electronic tax administration system and customs-to-financial-management integration reported for 2025
note: The circular is an image-only scan; its text was recovered by character recognition

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile money use
milestone: State of the Economy report 2024
position_end: 81.8% of Somalis use mobile money, on the National Economic Council's 2024 report

subject: dpi.pay
name: National Payment System
milestone: Launched July 2021; instant payment layer added January 2025
position_end: Automated clearing, real-time gross settlement and interbank funds transfer in service since July 2021, supporting bulk salary and vendor payment, with an instant payment layer added in January 2025

subject: dpi.pay
name: Public Financial Management Reform Strategy 2026-2030
milestone: Minister-approved, March 2026
position_end: Approved, recording daily bank reconciliation across treasury accounts and paperless commitment-to-payment, and setting payroll linkage to biometric identity verification among twelve very-high-priority measures

subject: dpi.pay
name: Somalia Instant Payment System (SIPS)
milestone: Central Bank set out the integration sequence, 26 July 2026
position_start: Live since January 2025 with seven institutions, operated on a commercial switching platform (2025-08)
position_end: Carrying person-to-person, merchant, government-to-person and person-to-government flows on ISO 20022, targeting 14 commercial banks and eight mobile money and e-wallet providers; mobile money integration has no published date (2026-07)
sources: 2026-07-26-sonna-central-bank-one-payments-network|2026-07-27-somalia-expand-instant-payment-system-hiiraan|2025-03-25 Somalia taps BPC to launch first nationwide instant payment system
note: Operated by the Somalia Payment Switch, a joint venture of the Central Bank and 13 commercial banks, which the Governor described as a deliberate choice over central-bank-run infrastructure.

subject: dpi.pay
name: SOMQR national QR payment standard
milestone: Linked to the instant payment system as the national standard
position_start: Launched alongside the instant payment system to reach traders without dedicated hardware (2025-08)
position_end: In service and linked to the instant payment system; no merchant count or transaction figure published (2026-07)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Birth registration coverage
milestone: Somali Health and Demographic Survey 2020
position_end: 6% of children under two registered at birth, under 1% holding a certificate (2020)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Business register
milestone: Registration system extended into second-tier cities and rural areas
position_start: An online register operating from the capital under the 2021 regulations
position_end: Extended into second-tier cities and rural areas, with women's share of business and identity registrations rising from 21 per cent in 2024 to 31 per cent in 2025, against a statistical register recording 174,149 establishments

subject: dpi.registry
name: Guidelines on registering marriage officiants and verifying marriage records
milestone: Issued by the justice ministry 2026-10-21
position_end: Officiants of Islamic marriages must register with the justice ministry, which sets licensing procedures and rules for verifying marriage records and protecting the personal information in them; member states, the judiciary and the Banadir administration are asked to coordinate

subject: dpi.registry
name: IOM and Netherlands COMPASS migration management programme
milestone: Launched 2026-10-05
position_end: A programme launched on 5 October 2026 by the migration agency, the federal government and the Netherlands will support civil registration and legal identity systems, expand registration in underserved areas and develop data-protection and information-sharing mechanisms, alongside protection and reintegration services; no budget or duration is stated

subject: dpi.registry
name: Karaar digital address pilots
milestone: Memoranda with four states and regions, reported 2024-12
position_end: A diaspora startup has piloted a system assigning verifiable digital addresses to homes in several cities, including Merca, with field teams verifying addresses claimed through its app, under memoranda with four states and regions

subject: dpi.registry
name: National land register and cadastre
milestone: Coordination platform terms of reference revised, September 2025
position_start: No functioning national land and property registration system, to the point that buying or selling land legally is described as virtually impossible; South West’s urban land law provides for a State Land Registry that would formalise urban ownership and use rights (2024-12)
position_end: Named as a future priority in the responsible ministry’s own five-year plan, with a national land-sector coordination platform being established; no operational national register or cadastre exists (2025-09)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Somali Business Registration System (ebusiness.gov.so)
milestone: Launched by the commerce ministry, March 2022
position_end: The commerce ministry's online business registration system went live after a pilot with 700 firms, targeting 5,000 registrations, 30% of them women-led, by 2025; World Bank additional financing of 2021 set aside US$2m to take online registration beyond Mogadishu. No later registration count is held

subject: dpi.registry
name: Somali Postal Service digital addressing system
milestone: Launch announced by the communications minister, June 2024
position_end: The communications minister announced the launch of the Somali Postal Service with a digital addressing system to let citizens receive goods bought abroad by direct delivery

subject: dpi.registry
name: Somaliland credit registry
milestone: Central bank to lead the credit information bureau, agreed with banks and mobile-money operators 2026-09-11
position_end: The Somaliland central bank and the International Finance Corporation agreed a path forward in August 2026, and on 11 September the central bank met banks and mobile-money operators on each party's role, the data required and how it will be shared, it being agreed that the central bank will lead the credit information bureau; no design, timetable or funding figure is on file
note: Somaliland institutions are carried under this unit because the repository places the record there.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Taxpayer register
milestone: 48,197 new registrations between July 2024 and August 2025
position_end: 48,197 new registrations, a 76 per cent increase excluding one member state, against an integrated tax administration system contracted but with online filing by large taxpayers still at nil

subject: dpi.registry
name: Unified digital civil registration system
milestone: Unified system documented on OpenCRVS, January 2026
position_start: Registration and vital statistics system handed over by NADRA in November 2024, with no district pilot running (2025-08)
position_end: Piloted across 19 districts on an open-source platform as the vital-events layer beneath legal identity; no registration coverage figure published (2026-01)
sources: 2026-01-16 OpenCRVS Somalia Unified Digital Civil Registration System|2025-08-11 Somalia pilots 19-district digital civil registry|2025-01-14-somalia-civil-registration-overhaul

subject: dpi.registry
name: Unified national registry of health facilities
milestone: First unified national registry launched in Mogadishu, 23 August 2026
position_end: The country’s first unified national registry of health facilities is launched, to underpin health-sector planning; no facility count, update cycle or public access route is on file

subject: dpi.registry
name: Unified Social Registry
milestone: Board approval of a USD 112 million operation, 25 September 2025
position_start: A registry supporting the existing safety-net caseload
position_end: Supporting over 500,000 households, with a USD 112 million operation approved to strengthen it and run a national socio-economic survey covering 12 million people

subject: dpi.mis
name: DHIS2 national health information system
milestone: 579 public facilities reporting, July to September 2023
position_end: The ministry counted 579 public health facilities reporting in July to September 2023, against 532 a year earlier, at an aggregate reporting rate of 95.8%, and its sector plan for 2022-2026 commits to it as the single reporting platform; a February 2026 training of health-centre staff in Bosaso shows reporting to it continuing

subject: dpi.mis
name: Digital Ebola travel health pass
milestone: Launched by the health minister 2026-10-22
position_end: An online pre-arrival health declaration built by the National Institute of Health, free to use and required of arrivals, introduced first at Aden Adde International Airport with other airports, seaports and land borders to follow on no stated timeline

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education Management Information System
milestone: Financing amendment committing to expansion, 1 October 2025
position_start: A piloted platform described as functional but under-used for planning
position_end: Functional and technically sound but under-used for planning, with a financing amendment committing to expansion, an integrated teacher management system and a distance-learning platform

subject: dpi.mis
name: Electronic Immunization Register
milestone: Piloted in 14 Banadir facilities with scaling to more than 80 planned
position_end: Running on an open-source health platform, assigning each vaccinated child a unique identifier with dose histories and SMS reminders, against about 60% of children recorded as zero-dose (2026-02)
note: Power and connectivity gaps force recording on paper and uploading later.

subject: dpi.mis
name: Integrated Electronic Case Management System
milestone: Unveiled in Mogadishu, 9 October 2025
position_end: Launched, linking criminal investigation, prosecution, courts and prisons in Mogadishu, with a separate three-year judiciary reform roadmap adopted in Somaliland committing to case-management modernisation

subject: dpi.mis
name: Integrated Tax Administration System
milestone: Contract signed after the September 2025 mid-term review
position_end: Contracted, alongside an operational financial management system and customs system, with online filing by large taxpayers still at nil

subject: dpi.mis
name: National Transformation Plan digital monitoring system
milestone: Launched by the planning ministry, 8 September 2026
position_end: A unified system for monitoring plan implementation across all 26 federal ministries, assessing each project against performance indicators, after a review of 153 donor-funded projects
note: no public dashboard, indicator set or data-sharing rule with the member states is published

subject: dpi.mis
name: Pandemic Fund health information project
milestone: Launched in Mogadishu 2026-08-20
position_end: A project to strengthen prevention, preparedness, detection and response for infectious disease and public health emergencies, launched by the health minister with a set of multilateral and regional partners
note: no budget, duration or surveillance-system specification is published

subject: dpi.mis
name: Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS)
milestone: Follow-up audit of 2024, covering the year to 31 December 2023
position_end: The federal government processed 93.5% of transactions through it by the close of the second public financial management project; a 2024 follow-up audit found 69.2% of high and medium general IT control findings not implemented, none of the business-continuity findings implemented, and over-dependence on a single developer

subject: dpi.mis
name: Subnational land information systems
milestone: Municipal GIS property databases in five towns across two federal member states
position_start: Geographic-information-based property and land-information systems supported across 59 districts under a local governance programme, with urban land-management legislation and no national register (2024-02)
position_end: Hargeisa holds a GIS database of more than 60,000 properties built for tax collection, which carries no ownership information, and similar databases exist in Boroma and Berbera; Garowe and Gardo have GIS databases established for the same purpose, and Garowe and Bossaso register land ownership and transfers at municipal level. South-Central Somalia is governed almost entirely by customary practice, its land services limited to witnessing transfers and guaranteeing titles (2024-12)
note: the databases were built for revenue rather than for tenure, and the largest of them records no ownership

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Danabeysan payment-authorisation e-signature platform
milestone: Launched by the finance minister, August 2025
position_end: Electronic signatures authorise government payments on a central platform where ministries and agencies approve and monitor transactions, linking authorisation to record-keeping, on top of the financial management information system in use since 2014
note: a signature for officials authorising payments, not a citizen authentication service

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digital voter registration
milestone: Nearly one million registered across Mogadishu’s 16 districts
position_start: Equipment unveiled by the electoral commission, with no registration exercise reported (2025-03)
position_end: The first voter registration held in Mogadishu in more than 55 years, run by the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission using biometric fingerprint capture on digital scanners, with nearly a million voters announced as registered across the city’s 16 districts; a poll of residents found 29 per cent of those registered saying they had been registered without their consent (2025-12)
sources: 2025-12-01-voter-registration-in-mogadishu|2025-03-18 Somalia's Electoral Commission unveils digital voter registration equipment
note: the registration total is the commission’s; the consent finding is a civil-society poll of Mogadishu residents, not a national measurement

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Federal electronic visa
milestone: Federal aviation authority declared the dispute resolved 2026-10-19; Somaliland denied it
position_start: In force, a fee exemption for one region under negotiation (2026-08)
position_end: In force; the federal civil aviation authority said on 19 October 2026 that the dispute with Somaliland was resolved, and Somaliland's aviation minister denied any agreement, saying federal e-visas still do not work for entry at Hargeisa
note: no issuance count, fee schedule or outcome of the negotiation is published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Government procurement portal of the National Procurement Directorate
milestone: Development tender closed May 2021
position_end: An EU-funded tender sought a firm to build a procurement portal for the finance ministry's National Procurement Directorate, closing in May 2021; nothing later on the repository records it in service

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Halmeel unified digital government services platform
milestone: Launch targeted for end-March 2027
position_end: A single interface for ministries, departments and agencies, opening with about 70 services and the national ID as the only accepted credential, with requests, tracking and payment in one place; a physical service centre runs in Mogadishu meanwhile (2026-10)
note: the launch date and service count are the centre's director general's, given in interview

subject: dpi.govtech
name: National job portal
milestone: Launched as a centralised, domestically hosted platform
position_start: Ministries recruiting separately through notices, radio and messaging groups (2025-08)
position_end: One centralised platform for public vacancies, hosted domestically; no vacancy or placement figure published (2026-02)

subject: dpi.govtech
name: National Single Window
milestone: Named as planned within the HoA DRIVE Somalia project, 3 August 2026
position_end: Planned, with no design, timetable or budget published; named alongside a Trade Information Portal and the existing SOMCAS and SOMLITS systems it is to connect to
note: Stated in an agenda piece by the National Trade Facilitation Coordinator, not in an instrument.

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Somali Customs Automated System (SOMCAS)
milestone: Independently audited for the year ended 31 December 2023
position_start: In service at Mogadishu Port, with the ministry publishing a business process guide for clearing goods through it (2024)
position_end: The Auditor General’s first independent audit of the system, for the year ended 31 December 2023, returned 34 findings — 23 high risk and 11 medium risk. It found no IT governance framework and no formal IT policies, no formal controls over data centre operations, no formalised backup and recovery process, and no escrow agreement over the source code, which the report puts as a legal and operational exposure (2025-01)
note: built by the Revenue Directorate with donor support; it handles customs declarations, duty and tax assessment, accounting, warehousing and transit

subject: digital.localgov
name: Baidoa property register and road naming
milestone: 21,400 properties registered, reported 2021-03
position_end: A UN-Habitat drive mapped and registered 21,400 properties in Baidoa on a GIS and named and signed its roads, projected to raise about USD 0.5m a year in property tax

subject: digital.localgov
name: Fariin Maal municipal citizen engagement platform
milestone: Launched by the municipality, 23 September 2025
position_end: Launched by Baidoa municipality as a citizen-engagement platform with external programme support

subject: digital.localgov
name: Financial Management Information System rollout to member states
milestone: Enhancement and rollout contract signed, announced 2026-09-08
position_start: A federal system with no member-state rollout
position_end: Contracted: the vendor signed with the finance ministry to enhance the federal financial management system and roll it out to four federal member states, replacing the system they use, with links to the human-resources and tax administration systems; no contract value is stated
note: the vendor's own announcement

subject: digital.localgov
name: Government backbone network
milestone: Completed 2020; 26 locations and 30 communications rooms
position_end: 26 locations in the capital and 30 communications rooms with videoconferencing and connectivity equipment, connected to federal ministries and public institutions across all member states

subject: digital.localgov
name: Mogadishu house-numbering and postcode programme
milestone: Launched by the mayor, January 2014
position_end: The Benadir administration launched street naming, house numbering and a postcode system for the capital in January 2014, funded with the business community, with property registration already begun; nothing later on the repository records its coverage

subject: digital.localgov
name: Puntland district FMIS and mobile property tax
milestone: Mobile taxation extended to four more districts, August 2021
position_end: Puntland district councils run a financial management system, Garowe from 2019 and others from 2021, with property tax billed and paid by mobile money: about 22,000 Garowe properties were geo-referenced by the close of the UN local governance programme in 2023, and a 2023 brief found only Puntland councils running such a system

subject: digital.localgov
name: SUMER revenue collection terminals (Hirshabelle)
milestone: Tariff-loaded terminals deployed at state border checkpoints
position_start: Paper vouchers carried up to 90km and hand-keyed, on a reconciliation cycle of 30 to 45 days (2025-08)
position_end: Terminals holding the tariff schedule on the device, paying over mobile money into the government account with real-time QR receipts (2026-07)
note: Collections at equipped posts are reported up 668.94% in the first quarter of 2026 against 2020; the figure comes only from the rollout's backers.

subject: digital.rural
name: Digital crime statistics system
milestone: Created under a programme running to November 2022
position_end: A digital crime-statistics system populated from police reporting nationwide, alongside nine police offices refurbished with equipment and collation units
note: The programme closed in November 2022 and nothing since reports the system's state

subject: digital.rural
name: Mobile identity registration units
milestone: 38,026 registered in a one-month Baidoa pilot against a 25,000 target
position_start: Registration requiring travel to a conventional office
position_end: Mobile teams taking registration to displacement camps and public spaces, registering 38,026 people in one month at under a dollar each, against over a million registered nationally and 12,000 to 15,000 daily

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital data capture
milestone: Electronic health record in 111 facilities across six states, 2023 to 2025
position_start: Facilities recording on paper, with district officers keying aggregates into the national platform
position_end: A national primary-care electronic health record in 111 facilities across six states, generating compliant aggregate reports automatically and raising reporting completeness from 85 to 96 per cent
note: A pastoralist, agricultural or rural registry, or a field data-collection programme covering rural populations.

subject: digital.rural
name: School electrification and device supply
milestone: Tablets received for 61 schools, June 2026
position_start: No solar or device programme contracted
position_end: Solar power and battery storage contracted for 57 schools across five regions, and solar-powered preloaded tablets received for 61 schools serving underserved communities

subject: tech.ai
name: Garad.ai
milestone: Launched 2026-08-07
position_end: Launched by a private artificial-intelligence centre alongside the communications and technology ministry; the state minister for communications used the launch to set out the ministry's wider technology-sector policy push and to say a National Data Centre is planned
note: the record describes the launch, not the product; no capability, language coverage, user base or hosting arrangement for Garad.ai is stated

subject: tech.ai
name: Goobo Labs Somali speech recognition model
milestone: Model released May 2026
position_end: A Mogadishu lab released a Somali speech-recognition model trained on 320 hours of audio, reporting an 11.4% word error rate on its own figures

subject: tech.ai
name: Himilo 7B Somali language model
milestone: Announced by the start-up's founder, March 2025
position_end: A 7-billion-parameter Somali generative model from the start-up Sykli Intelligence, under evaluation for safety and performance, with healthcare and education variants in development and open-sourcing stated as the aim
note: the founder's own announcement; no release is on record

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI centre at the national university
milestone: Launched at the leading public university, reported 2026-07-17
position_end: The centre, previously under the communications ministry, was integrated into the leading public university, to work on machine learning, Somali-language processing, computer vision, AI ethics and data science

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI readiness assessment
milestone: A university joined the assessment 2026-08-17
position_end: Under way, led by the communications and technology ministry with UNESCO, examining artificial-intelligence policy, data governance and higher-education capacity for artificial intelligence; a private university joined the exercise on 17 August 2026
note: no methodology, participant list, score or publication date is stated

subject: tech.ai
name: National artificial intelligence policy
milestone: ESCWA terms of reference for a consultant to draft the strategy, 2025
position_end: At the communications authority's request, UN-ESCWA advertised for a local consultant to draft a national artificial intelligence strategy (2025); no strategy had been published as at June 2026
note: the terms of reference carry no posting date; the year is inferred

subject: tech.ai
name: Placing on the Africa AI Governance Index
milestone: Nineteenth of 54, scoring 1.50 of four, 2026 edition
position_end: Nineteenth of 54, scoring 1.50 of four (2026, evidence to 30 June 2026)
note: the index is the Lawyers Hub's; 56 of 80 indicators scored; earlier editions are not held

subject: tech.ai
name: Predictive food-security monitoring
milestone: Used in Burhakaba district to bring forward assistance
position_end: A predictive food-security platform released in April 2026, used to detect deteriorating malnutrition earlier and inform assistance to 48,000 people and nutrition support to 3,000 women and children

subject: tech.ai
name: SAADAAL climate early-warning system
milestone: Deployed with a state disaster-management ministry
position_end: A Somali-built early-warning system using artificial intelligence over environmental and climate data, deployed as part of a state ministry's disaster-preparedness infrastructure rather than as a pilot. A senior government adviser told a food-systems forum panel in Kigali on 5 September 2026 that the disaster management agency is building systems so that government holds full ownership of disaster data (2026-09)

subject: tech.ai
name: SIMAD AI Institute Somali language technology project
milestone: Datasets and prototype models in development, 2026-01
position_end: A university AI institute is building Somali text and speech models for public services, research and content moderation, at the stage of dataset preparation and prototype models

subject: tech.ai
name: Somali National University AI Centre
milestone: Launched by the university, July 2026
position_end: Established for research and digital skills; no funding, staffing or research output stated (2026-07)

subject: tech.ai
name: SomBERTa Somali language model
milestone: Paper published on arXiv, March 2025
position_end: A transformer-based monolingual Somali language model, described by its authors as the first of its kind, fine-tuned on two human-annotated social-media datasets for fake-news and toxicity classification and reported to outperform multilingual comparators at 87.99% average accuracy; code and data to be released under academic licence
note: a research paper, not a deployed system

subject: tech.industry
name: Domestic ICT sector
milestone: Five major operators employing about 25,000 people
position_end: Five major mobile operators employing about 25,000 people in a largely Somali-owned sector that grew through the civil war, with mobile money at 150 million transactions a month and 36 per cent of GDP
note: The last sector-wide employment and transaction figures the repository holds are from the 2019 policy

subject: tech.industry
name: National e-commerce strategy
milestone: Still at its November 2022 baseline against an April 2028 target
position_end: None published (2026-06-16)
note: A results indicator of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project; the World Bank records that no strategy exists in Somalia, South Sudan or IGAD

subject: tech.industry
name: Technical training and service facility
milestone: Partnership announced May 2026
position_end: A standards-aligned technical training and service facility to be established in Mogadishu, training youth in electrical equipment servicing and information-technology hardware and networking

subject: tech.innovate
name: National startup network
milestone: Unveiled at the innovation forum in Mogadishu, 22 July 2026
position_end: Connecting startups to incubators, chambers of commerce and agencies, on European Union funding implemented by UNIDO; the project reports 3,600 applications across three cohorts and more than 200 startups incubated (2026-07)
note: The same account states that intellectual-property legislation is being developed; no bill, text or timeline is on file.

subject: tech.innovate
name: Red Sea University innovation hub, Bosaso
milestone: Opened April 2026
position_end: Opened in Bosaso with the youth ministry, the mayor and private-sector representatives present, extending the hub network into Puntland

subject: tech.innovate
name: Regulator partnership with iRise Hub
milestone: Memorandum signed, 30 July 2026
position_end: Memorandum covering innovation, skills, cybersecurity and research with no figure, term, named deliverable or funder (2026-07)

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programmes
milestone: 80 youth trained across four tracks in 2025
position_end: A ministry and partner programme training 80 youth in cybersecurity, data analysis, digital marketing and online business in 2025, within a project targeting 1,000
note: A national digital literacy curriculum, campaign or programme document.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: ICT training of civil servants
milestone: Survey of 138 government employees
position_end: A survey of 138 government employees found wide access to computers but gaps in structured, regular ICT training

subject: capacity.training
name: Accredited cybersecurity certification chapter
milestone: Country chapter launched December 2025
position_end: An internationally recognised, vendor-neutral cybersecurity certification and training pathway hosted at a Mogadishu university faculty, launched with the regulator and an external certification body

subject: capacity.training
name: Certified cybersecurity training for government ICT staff
milestone: Internationally certified courses run in Mogadishu and Nairobi, March to May 2026
position_end: Delivered by the regulator in partnership with the World Bank Group, covering incident management and response, cloud data security and the auditing of security policies; no participant total published (2026-04)

subject: capacity.training
name: Computer science graduate outcomes
milestone: Surveyed among 300 Mogadishu graduates in January 2026
movement: No change, a first measurement with no earlier figure behind it
position_end: 61.0 per cent employed in computer-science roles and 79.7 per cent planning to seek work abroad, with limited openings, nepotistic hiring and skills gaps named as the barriers

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital skills programme for government employees (National Institute of Telecommunications and Technology)
milestone: Launched 2026-10-17 with a data-protection workshop
position_end: The communications ministry's telecommunications and technology institute launched a programme to raise government employees' digital skills, opening with a workshop on data protection, information security and privacy
note: no participant count, duration or curriculum is stated

subject: capacity.training
name: Fixed asset management training (Somaliland administration)
milestone: Training launched, 4 August 2026
position_end: Training run to support fixed-asset recording in public financial management; no participant total, system or completion date stated (2026-08)

subject: capacity.training
name: Higher education digital readiness
status: Implemented, no institution above tier three
milestone: Assessed across 50 institutions in 2026
position_end: 50 institutions assessed across infrastructure, human capacity, governance, budgeting, security and emerging technologies, with none above the third of four tiers

subject: capacity.training
name: National Cybersecurity Academy
milestone: Announced by the communications minister at the fourth national cybersecurity forum, reported 2026-10-27
position_end: The communications minister said a National Cybersecurity Academy is planned for later in 2026; no host, budget or intake is stated

subject: capacity.training
name: Professional certification programme
milestone: First cohort graduated October 2025
position_end: 207 graduates across five digital tracks, with the programme reporting USD 42,963 in verified graduate income and over 90 per cent in work, freelancing or enterprise
note: Outcome figures are the programme's own and are not independently audited

subject: capacity.training
name: Secondary-school learning management system pilot
milestone: Procurement notice issued 4 May 2026
position_end: A pilot procured for 15 secondary schools in six cities, covering equipment and connectivity, teacher training in the platform and digital skills, and 100 bilingual mathematics and science lessons

subject: capacity.training
name: University graduates in computer science and IT
milestone: Graduate count for 2022
position_end: 25,230 first-degree graduates from 69 universities in 2022, computer science and IT the largest field at 3,136

subject: capacity.research
name: University research partnership on official microdata
milestone: Three-day technical workshop closed with three partner universities, July 2026
position_end: A pilot training researchers from three universities on the statistics bureau's household budget and labour force microdata, funded by the Swiss development agency with no amount stated (2026-07)

subject: include.access
name: Act for Internally Displaced People (Law 42 of 2025)
milestone: Signed into law 4 December 2025, gazetted 21 December
position_start: A 2019 policy with no statutory force
position_end: In force, affirming equal access to public services and legal documentation, prohibiting a separate legal status for displaced people, creating a sixteen-ministry technical committee and earmarking at least 3 per cent of the national budget

subject: include.access
name: Assistive technology distribution for blind people
milestone: Pilot distribution in Mogadishu
position_end: A diaspora-run pilot distributing individually adapted speaking mobile phones to blind people in Mogadishu, for communication and mobile banking access

subject: include.access
name: Biometric ID enrolment of returnees from Yemen
milestone: Announced by NIRA 2026-10-21
position_end: NIRA and the refugee and displaced-persons commission are enrolling citizens returning from Yemen for the biometric national ID at the commission's reception camp; no count of returnees enrolled is published

subject: include.access
name: Girls in ICT programme
milestone: 2026 forum opened by the communications minister
position_end: An annual ministry forum organised with the national telecommunications institute and a leadership hub, attended by the education minister and girls studying technology

subject: include.access
name: Identity registration initiative for displaced people
milestone: Launched June 2026 with external funding
position_end: An initiative to give internally displaced people the national identity card and equal access to public services, jointly implemented with a refugee agency

subject: include.access
name: National budget consultation
milestone: 308 in person and up to 1,700 online, October 2025
position_end: A three-day national consultation with 308 in-person and up to 1,700 online participants across government, civil society and the private sector, with recorded questions and agreed follow-up feeding the budget

subject: include.access
name: Regional digital project grievance mechanism
milestone: Manual published for the regional digital project
position_end: A formal multi-level grievance and feedback mechanism with a hotline, messaging, email and suggestion boxes, running from community through member state to ministry

subject: include.divides
name: Internet use by sex
milestone: Integrated household budget survey 2022
position_end: 30.8% of males and 24.7% of females aged 10 and over used the internet in 2022, with mobile phone ownership near parity

subject: include.divides
name: Smartphone financing programme
milestone: More than 2,500 phones sold; extension to 15 branches in four states, 2026-09-25
position_end: More than 2,500 smartphones sold since the May 2026 launch against a target of 100,000 by end-2026, with the programme extending through 15 more branches in Jubaland, South West, Hirshabelle and Galmudug; early data on nearly 1,700 August contracts show 89.7% repayment among low-scored borrowers against 90.5% at the top band, and about 89% first-time smartphone buyers
note: the operator's and its partner's own figures

subject: data.statistics
name: Economic update, eleventh edition
milestone: Edition published May 2026
position_end: The eleventh edition of the country economic update, held in full
note: a macroeconomic publication held as a primary; no digital-sector chapter or indicator is broken out here

subject: data.statistics
name: Governance Statistics Report
milestone: Second edition published 2024
position_end: a second edition compiling justice, security and civil-service figures from administrative records, which finds no national cybercrime data

subject: data.statistics
name: Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey 7
milestone: Formally launched 26 March 2026
position_end: Launched across 17 of 18 pre-war regions to produce 168 indicators including 47 development-goal measures, alongside a separate socio-demographic survey of five districts using geospatial modelling

subject: data.statistics
name: Quarterly Statistical Bulletin
milestone: Fourth-quarter 2024 edition
position_end: A quarterly bulletin from the statistics bureau on consumer prices, trade, exchange rates and remittances, drawn from administrative sources (Q4 2024)

subject: data.statistics
name: SDG reporting platform (MARS)
milestone: Launched August 2024
position_end: a platform through which ministries report SDG indicator data to the statistics bureau, launched in August 2024, with 35 ministry data providers trained on it

subject: data.statistics
name: Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics
milestone: Unveiled 7 December 2025, covering 2024 to 2029
position_end: In implementation and recorded as due for mid-term review, superseding the 2017 to 2023 strategy

subject: data.statistics
name: Somali Population and Housing Census
milestone: Launched 2023; the first census since 1975
position_end: Under way as the first census since 1975, covering all member states plus the capital region and Somaliland, with remote sensing used for inaccessible areas

subject: data.statistics
name: Somalia Facts & Figures
milestone: Eighth edition compiled October 2025
position_end: An annual pocket compendium compiled by the statistics bureau, its eighth edition covering 2024

subject: data.statistics
name: Statistical Abstract
milestone: First edition compiled November 2024
position_end: a first edition of a biennial compendium compiled by the statistics bureau from surveys and ministry administrative records

subject: data.open
name: DataCite national consortium
milestone: Led by the national research and education network, 2026-09
position_end: Somalia's first national consortium in the persistent-identifier network, letting universities and research centres mint DOIs for more than 30 types of research output and data
note: no member count or first DOI volume is published

subject: data.open
name: Open government data
milestone: Portal terms of use published 13 July 2024
position_end: An open-data platform under a CC-BY 4.0 licence in machine-readable formats with a stated update cadence, alongside a government portal listing eight datasets across ten ministries
note: An open-data portal, a published dataset release policy, or an agency statement on publishing government data.

subject: data.satellite
name: African Risk Capacity sovereign drought insurance
milestone: Crop payout triggered for the 2024-25 Deyr season, April 2025
position_end: The African Risk Capacity drought insurance, modelled on satellite rainfall, triggered a crop payout of about US$2.18m for the government and its replica partner the Start Network after the poor 2024 Deyr rains

subject: data.satellite
name: Civil aviation authority satellite weather system
milestone: Launched July 2025
position_end: The civil aviation authority replaced a decade-old platform with a Meteosat Third Generation receiver in Mogadishu, a PUMA-2025 workstation and access to the ClimSA platform, used by air traffic controllers and meteorologists to monitor lightning and convective storms

subject: data.satellite
name: Combined drought index as an anticipatory-action trigger
milestone: Funded project approved February 2026
position_start: A monitoring product with no funded trigger behind it
position_end: A satellite-derived combined drought index made the trigger for disaster-agency decisions under a SEK 20 million anticipatory-action project reaching over 5,600 households

subject: data.satellite
name: DRIVE satellite index-based livestock insurance
milestone: US$3.88m paid to 17,734 pastoralists, Mogadishu, 2 March 2026
position_end: Insurance bought by pastoralists and triggered when a satellite pasture index crosses a drought threshold, financed by the World Bank and run by the reinsurer ZEP-RE with the government; after the failed 2025 short rains it paid US$3.88m to 17,734 pastoralists, its largest single payout

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth observation or geospatial data programme
milestone: Remote-sensing service operated by a partner information unit
position_end: A partner-run remote-sensing service estimating cultivable area and production, mapping land use and monitoring degradation, alongside a routine monthly national vegetation index series
note: No sovereign earth-observation programme is held; a national meteorological agency is being established

subject: data.satellite
name: Somali National Meteorological Agency
milestone: Strategic plan for its establishment released December 2025
position_start: No established national meteorological service, duties distributed across several bodies
position_end: A five-year strategic plan released for establishing the agency, against an assessment finding meteorological duties spread across several bodies and satellite and model products filling the observational gap

subject: data.satellite
name: Somalia Water and Land Information Management programme 2026-2030
milestone: US$1.4m Swiss commitment reported by the implementing agency
position_end: A Swiss-funded grant of about US$1.4m, reported by the UN food agency for 2026 to 2030, to sustain and institutionalise national water, land, climate and geospatial information services; US$61,977 was spent by September 2026
note: a commitment record rather than a service report

subject: geopol.usa
name: Satellite internet reseller channel
milestone: Second authorised reseller announced November 2025
position_start: A licensed operator with one local reseller
position_end: A second authorised reseller serving organisations and field teams nationwide, following the operating licence granted at a Mogadishu ceremony in April 2025

subject: geopol.china
name: Chinese digital cooperation with Somalia
milestone: Satellite-imagery memorandum signed April 2026
position_start: A strategic partnership with no digital instrument named
position_end: A memorandum between the space and satellite department and China's land satellite remote-sensing centre covering imagery application, technical cooperation and knowledge exchange
note: A bilateral agreement, vendor contract or financing arrangement naming Somalia.

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation with Somalia
milestone: Innovation-hub network launched July 2026 under an EU-funded project
position_end: An EU-funded project convening innovation forums in Mogadishu and Hargeisa and linking three innovation hubs into a network under a memorandum with harmonised incubation standards
note: A Global Gateway or EU delegation announcement, a financing agreement, or a programme document naming Somalia beyond the innovation project already held.

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Agreements with the United Arab Emirates
milestone: All agreements terminated by the Council of Ministers
position_start: Port operations, federal-institution collaborations and security cooperation in force
position_end: All agreements terminated — port operations at three ports, federal-institution collaborations and security and defence cooperation — on sovereignty and territorial-integrity grounds

subject: geopol.india
name: Indian digital cooperation with Somalia
milestone: Joined the Pan-African e-Network in August 2010
position_end: Participation in a tele-education and tele-health network since 2010 and its successor programme, plus a 2018 diplomatic training arrangement; no current digital-infrastructure instrument
note: A bilateral memorandum, a line-of-credit agreement, or an India Stack or ITEC programme document naming Somalia.
